title: hieracium ammobium
intro: Hieracium ammobium, commonly known as woolly hawk's-beard, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Asia. It is a flowering plant known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as wound healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium ammobium include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
